tag.name: Plans
tag.description: Recurring service plans and their lifecycle actions (pause, resume, cancel, skip, charge).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:plans`

Returns the tenant's recurring plans, newest first (ordered by `created_at` descending). Each plan embeds a minimal `customer` object (`id`, `display_name`). This endpoint is not paginated: it returns every plan for the tenant in a single response under the `data` key.

data.description: The tenant's recurring plans, each with an embedded `customer` summary.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:plans`

Creates a recurring plan template plus its line items (at least one item is required). The plan and its items are written sequentially; if the item insert fails the plan row is rolled back so no header is ever left without items.

`next_invoice_at` is always computed server-side from `cadence_rrule` and `start_date` (defaulting to now) — any client-supplied value is ignored. The new plan starts with status `active`.

Auto-charge is gated server-side: even if `auto_charge_enabled` is sent as `true`, it is forced to `false` unless an active `auto_pay_recurring` payment consent already exists for the customer. An invalid RRULE returns 400.

201.description: The created plan row. The response also includes a `plan_id` field mirroring `id`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:plans`

Returns a single recurring plan template plus its line items (in sort order) and an embedded `customer` summary. Returns 404 if the plan does not exist within the caller's tenant.

200.description: The recurring plan, with embedded `customer` and `items`.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:plans`

Updates the plan template only; previously generated invoices are never retroactively mutated. Every field is optional — only fields present in the body are touched. Unknown keys (including `customer_id`, which cannot be changed) are rejected with 400.

If `items` is supplied it must contain at least one entry; an empty/zero-item result is rejected with 400. The scalar update and item replacement run as a single atomic RPC.

If `cadence_rrule` changes, `next_invoice_at` is recomputed from now (an invalid RRULE returns 400). Enabling `auto_charge_enabled` is re-verified against an active `auto_pay_recurring` consent and silently forced to `false` if none exists.

200.description: The updated plan, with embedded `customer` and `items`.

Plan.description: A recurring plan template. The list endpoint embeds a minimal `customer` object; the get/update endpoints additionally embed the plan's `items` array. The create endpoint returns the raw plan row plus a `plan_id` field mirroring `id`. Additional database columns may be present.

plan_id.description: Mirror of `id`. Only present on the create (POST) response.

job_series_id.description: Linked job series id, or null.

cadence_rrule.description: iCalendar RRULE string describing the billing cadence.

auto_charge_enabled.description: Whether the plan auto-charges the customer's saved method. Server-gated on an active `auto_pay_recurring` consent.

payment_method_id.description: Saved payment method to charge, or null.

next_invoice_at.description: Server-computed timestamp of the next invoice generation.

last_generated_for.description: Date of the most recent generated invoice period, or null.

lead_offset_days.description: Number of days before the cadence date that the invoice is generated.

default_tax_rate_id.description: Default tax rate applied to taxable items, or null.

created_by.description: User id that created the plan, or null.

items.description: Embedded plan line items. Present on the get and update responses.

PlanItem.description: A line item on a recurring plan template. Pricing is applied at invoice-generation time, not on the template.

is_taxable.description: Whether this line is taxable. Defaults to true.

tax_rate_id.description: Per-line tax rate override, or null.

sort_order.description: Display/sort order of the line within the plan.

PlanItemInput.description: A line item supplied when creating or updating a plan.

quantity.description: Quantity. Must be a positive number.

unit_price.description: Unit price. Must be zero or greater.

is_taxable.description: Whether this line is taxable. Defaults to true.

PlanCreate.description: Payload to create a recurring plan. At least one item is required.

cadence_rrule.description: iCalendar RRULE string describing the billing cadence. Validated server-side; an invalid value returns 400.

lead_offset_days.description: Days before the cadence date that the invoice is generated.

auto_charge_enabled.description: Request auto-charge. Forced to false server-side unless an active `auto_pay_recurring` consent exists for the customer.

default_tax_rate_id.description: Default tax rate applied to taxable items.

start_date.description: Optional ISO-8601 anchor for the first `next_invoice_at` computation. Defaults to now.

items.description: Plan line items. At least one is required.

PlanUpdate.description: Payload to update a recurring plan template. All fields are optional; only supplied fields are changed. Unknown keys (including `customer_id`) are rejected with 400. `customer_id` and `status` cannot be changed here — status transitions live on dedicated action routes.

cadence_rrule.description: New RRULE. If changed, `next_invoice_at` is recomputed from now; an invalid value returns 400.

payment_method_id.description: New saved payment method, or null to clear.

auto_charge_enabled.description: Enable/disable auto-charge. Enabling is re-verified against an active `auto_pay_recurring` consent and forced to false if none exists.

default_tax_rate_id.description: New default tax rate, or null to clear.

notes.description: New notes, or null to clear.

items.description: Replacement set of plan line items. When present, must contain at least one item; the full item set is replaced.
